Usage: sysml2tools query <verb> [options] <files...>

Verbs:
  uses           List the elements a given element uses
  used-by        List the elements that use a given element
  impact         Report the transitive impact of a change to a given element
  describe       Describe a single element in detail
  hierarchy      Report the specialization/generalization hierarchy of a given element
  requirements   List requirements satisfied, verified, or traced to a given element
  interface      Describe the ports and interfaces of a given element
  connections    List the connections attached to a given element
  states         List the states and transitions of a given state-machine element
  list           List elements in the workspace, optionally filtered
  find           Search the workspace for elements matching a filter

Options:
  --element <name>, -e <name>  Qualified name of the target element (required for
                                every verb except 'list' and 'find')
  --format markdown|json       Output format (default: markdown); note this is a
